# AFN Medya — Web, Yazilim ve Growth Studio

> AFN Medya is a Turkish creative technology and digital studio specializing in web design, custom software development, and social media management. We help businesses build a strong, trust-inspiring digital presence that generates leads and drives growth.

## Company

- **Name:** AFN Medya (a brand of AFN Teknoloji)
- **Type:** Digital agency / Creative technology studio
- **Location:** Turkey
- **Website:** https://medya.afnteknoloji.com
- **Contact:** https://medya.afnteknoloji.com/iletisim/
- **Languages:** Turkish (primary), English

## Services

- **Web Design & Corporate Websites:** Modern, conversion-focused websites that reflect brand identity and inspire trust. Fast, mobile-first, lead-generating.
- **Custom Software Development:** Tailored management panels, workflow automation, and bespoke software solutions aligned with business processes.
- **Social Media Management:** Brand voice strategy, content planning, advertising support, and reporting to build audience and visibility.

## Positioning

AFN Medya believes digital presence should be clear, not cluttered. Rather than offering disconnected services, we build cohesive digital systems — combining strategy, design, and execution under one roof. The result is not just a good-looking site, but one that builds trust and converts visitors into clients.

---

## Turkce / Turkish

**AFN Medya**, web tasarim, ozel yazilim gelistirme ve sosyal medya yonetimi alanlarinda uzmanlasmis, Turkiye merkezli bir kreatif teknoloji ve dijital studyodur. Sirketlerin dijital varliklarini guclendirerek teklif ve musteri kazanmalarini hedefleriz.

### Hizmetler
- **Web Tasarim:** Markayi yansitan, guven veren ve donusum odakli kurumsal web siteleri.
- **Yazilim Gelistirme:** Is akisina ozel yonetim panelleri, otomasyon araclari ve yazilim cozumleri.
- **Sosyal Medya Yonetimi:** Marka dili olusturma, icerik planlamasi, reklam destegi ve raporlama.
